## Prebuilt capability versus custom training

If a managed service directly fits a standard capability and its quality, region and privacy constraints are acceptable, it can reduce implementation and model-operations effort. Custom workflows fit needs requiring specialized training or control.

### Reasoning and trade-offs

Textract targets document text extraction. Polly generates speech and the other services do not provide OCR. Evaluation still needs to measure handwriting, forms, layout and error behavior for the actual documents.

### Avoid this trap

A prebuilt API is not guaranteed to meet a regulated workload accuracy or data-handling requirements. Evaluate representative examples and current feature availability.

### Apply it

A team needs to extract text from scanned forms without operating an OCR training pipeline. Which service category best matches the first evaluation?

**Recommended design:** Evaluate Amazon Textract against representative documents and privacy requirements.

Does a prebuilt model remove the need to evaluate accuracy?
cards.answer: No. Test representative inputs and governance requirements.

quiz.question: A team needs to extract text from scanned forms without operating an OCR training pipeline. Which service category best matches the first evaluation?
options: Use Amazon Polly as the OCR engine for scanned pages.
Use an RDS read replica to recognize text in images.
Evaluate Amazon Textract against representative documents and privacy requirements.
Use Route 53 weighted routing to convert page pixels to structured text.

## Language, speech and operational fit

Transcribe converts supported speech to text; Polly converts text to speech; Comprehend provides supported natural-language analysis. Match the direction and output of the task before comparing deployment details.

### Reasoning and trade-offs

The first required transformation is speech to text, which is the Transcribe use case. Text analytics follows transcription, while speech synthesis goes in the reverse direction. Accuracy depends on audio conditions and configuration.

### Avoid this trap

Do not assume one language service handles every language, document format or custom terminology equally. Check supported features, region availability and data-governance requirements.

### Apply it

A contact center wants transcripts from recorded calls before running text analytics. Which service should produce the initial transcript?

**Recommended design:** Amazon Transcribe, configured and evaluated for the call language and audio quality.

The first required transformation is speech to text, which is the Transcribe use case. Text analytics follows transcription, while speech synthesis goes in the reverse direction. Accuracy depends on audio conditions and configuration.
